items.title: In characteristic zero smoothness at a prime, freeness of the differentials and regularity agree
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in characteristic zero smoothness at a prime, freeness of the module of differentials at that prime, and regularity of the local ring are equivalent for a finite type algebra over a field (statement lines 39037-39049). The proof does not reprove the general theory: it uses separability in characteristic zero for one equivalence, the definition for one implication, and then proves regularity from freeness of the differentials by an induction that divides out a nonzerodivisor and applies the regularity criterion (proof lines 39051-39084). Choosing the nonzerodivisor so that the induction descends is the step that carries the last implication. H2.
